pull_requests.title: feat(pricing): add wholesale invoices and make line_total net by default
pull_requests.body: Wholesale invoices are net of tax, and most new callers want the net amount, so line_total now leaves tax out unless add_tax=True is passed. receipt passes add_tax=True, so till receipts are unchanged. Adds invoice(items), which returns net lines and a net total.

pull_requests.title: feat(basket): add basket_summary for the checkout page
pull_requests.body: basket_summary(items) takes (name, unit_cents, quantity) tuples and returns each line with its tax-inclusive total, the number of units, and the tax-inclusive basket total the checkout page shows the shopper.
